items.exampleEn: How do you go to work?
I eat breakfast, and then I go to school.
items.exampleZh: 我吃完早餐，然後去上學。

items.exampleEn: The dog is playing with its ball.
Our house is near the station.
Can I have more rice, please?
items.exampleZh: 可以再給我多一點飯嗎？

items.exampleEn: I like dogs. I also like cats.
I am happy because it is Friday.
items.exampleZh: 因為今天是星期五，所以我很開心。

items.audioEn: Nina is not at school because she is sick.
items.audioZh: Nina 沒去學校，因為她生病了。

items.sentenceEn: These apples are from our garden.
items.sentenceZh: 這些蘋果是我們花園種的。

items.stemEn: I stay home ____ it is raining.
items.stemZh: 因為在下雨，所以我待在家裡。

items.stemEn: First I wash my hands, ____ I eat.

items.passageEn: Our family has a cat. Its name is Momo. Every morning, Momo eats its food and then sleeps in the sun. My sister also loves Momo. She gives it more food because it is always hungry. How happy Momo is!
items.passageZh: 我們家有一隻貓，牠的名字叫 Momo。每天早上，Momo 吃完飯後就在陽光下睡覺。我妹妹也很愛 Momo，她會多給牠一些食物，因為牠總是很餓。Momo 真是幸福啊！

questions.questionZh: Momo 吃完早餐後做什麼？
妹妹為什麼多給 Momo 食物？

items.promptZh: 我很累，因為我昨天很晚睡。
referenceEn: I am tired because I went to bed late yesterday.
I'm tired because I went to bed late yesterday.
rubricZh: 昨天的事用過去式（例如 went to bed late、stayed up late）
「很晚睡」可寫 went to bed late 或 stayed up late

items.instructionZh: 用 also 造一個句子，說說你喜歡的另一樣東西。
referenceEn: I like music. I also like sports.
I like tea. I also like milk.
rubricZh: also 放在一般動詞前、be 動詞後

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 規定昨天的事用過去式 went，會排除同樣正確的「很晚睡」譯法（如 I stayed up late last night.）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 要點改為「昨天的事用過去式（例如 went to bed late、stayed up late）」，不寫死單一動詞
